title: Gemini 1.5 Pro General Availability on Vertex AI
summary: Google Cloud's Vertex AI release notes record Gemini 1.5 Pro (gemini-1.5-pro-001) as generally available on May 24, 2024, alongside Gemini 1.5 Flash (gemini-1.5-flash-001).
significance: A dated production-availability boundary for Gemini 1.5 Pro on Vertex AI, kept distinct from its earlier private/public preview milestones and consumer availability in Gemini Advanced.

verification.note: Google Cloud's first-party Vertex AI release notes explicitly date general availability of gemini-1.5-pro-001 and gemini-1.5-flash-001 to May 24, 2024. This corrects the open research expectation that GA would occur in June: Google's May 14 announcement said GA would follow in June, but the authoritative dated release ledger records GA on May 24. This record is scoped to Vertex AI general availability and does not infer a universal cross-product release boundary. No development geography, ancestry, influence, causality, universal priority, or relationship edges are inferred.

candidateMeta.admissionReason: Google Cloud's first-party dated release ledger explicitly establishes May 24, 2024 as the Vertex AI GA boundary for Gemini 1.5 Pro 001.
